title: Armored Figure with Scales
description: A heavy person in black metal armor sits on a dark stone platform with eyes closed. The right hand holds a white feather pen and writes in an open book resting on the lap while the left hand rests on a large decorated shield and the feet stand on another burning book.
prompt: heavy person wearing black metal armor with many 1000 labels sits centered with closed eyes writing in an open book using a white feather pen in the right hand while the left hand rests on a large shield the feet stand on another open book with flames the background is a swirling purple vortex with hanging scales that read 1000 pounds and a sword
